title: Creator Rate Card and Media Kit Template, Influencer Rate Calculator, UGC Rate Card, Instagram TikTok YouTube, Excel Google Sheets
description:
Know your rate before the brand asks. This kit turns your own views into a rate for every deliverable, then gives you a one-page media kit and rate card to send with your reply.

What it does for you:
• Rate calculator: floor, rate and ask for Reels, Stories, carousels, TikToks, Shorts and YouTube
• Built on views, not followers, because views are what a brand pays for
• Designed media kit and rate card: 2 pages you edit in Canva, Google Slides, PowerPoint or Keynote
• Spreadsheet media kit: one printable page with your numbers, audience and "rates from", filled in for you
• Rate card: your deliverables, add-ons for ad use, exclusivity and rush, and your terms
• Engagement worked out per platform from your own averages
• 3 brand replies: the first DM, a low offer and a gifted-only ask

What's in the download:
• 2 spreadsheets: Sample (a made-up creator) and Blank
• The designed media kit and rate card (.pptx, 2 pages)
• A 2-page quick-start PDF with the 3 replies

Good to know:
• Works in Microsoft 365, Excel 2019 or newer and Google Sheets
• Any currency. Every number is yours to set, including your price per 1,000 views
• Example numbers only, never a promise of income
• Made with AI assistance, then built and checked by hand
• Want a quote builder, deal tracker, invoice and 12 replies? Look for the Pro edition
• Digital download, nothing ships

From Hourback, a Steadfold studio.
